newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Editorial urges local governments to pay attention to re-employment of laid off workers
- President Jiang Zemin meets U.S. visitors, says relations can make further progress
- China Machinery Equipment Group, composed of 29 organisations and total assets of 12.9 billion yuan, founded
- China produced 148 million tonnes of crude oil and three million tonnes of ethylene in 1996.
- China issues second set of rules on auditing listed firms
- National survey finds China's 1995 off-budgetary funds at 384.3 billion yuan.
- A total of 131 companies and organisations have become shareholders in Everbright Bank
- Head office of central bank recruits six officials through examination
- Minsheng Bank plans to train all middle and high level managers in Hong Kong, Singapore, and other locations.
- China's stock experts see 1997 as basically bullish.
- China rural telephone users seen rising by six to seven million a year from 1996 to 2000.
- China sets tobacco purchase target at 2.3785 tonnes for 1997.
